contact.full_name: AUTOMATION & PROCESS EXCELLENCE LEADER | FINANCE SHARED SERVICES | F&A TRANSFORMATION | SIX SIGMA |

data.summary:
Accomplished transformation and process excellence leader with 20+ years of experience across consulting, Finance Shared Services/BPO, technology, automation and operational improvement, including 14 years of Finance Shared Services/BPO experience. Hands-on exposure to R2R, P2P and O2C, budgeting, financial modelling and profitability planning, with strong capability in F&A consulting, current-state assessment, process-gap and opportunity analysis, solution design, ERP enhancement and transformation. Experienced in assessing current-state processes, identifying gaps/opportunities, creating opportunity charts for AP/AR/R2R, developing recommendations and solutions, and supporting implementation. Delivered large-scale finance transformation across multi-region environments, including 2,000+ Finance SSC automations and 100+ Root Cause Analyses. Brings practical experience with GenAI/AI reporting and SAP agent development, combined with Six Sigma, Agile, Lean, stakeholder management and change leadership.
LEAN SIX SIGMA & PROCESS EXCELLENCE HIGHLIGHTS • Managed and coordinated 8 Lean Six Sigma White Belt and Yellow Belt programmes, with an average batch size of 12 participants
per programme.
Conducted Lean Six Sigma capability-building sessions through the Opportunity Hopper programme twice annually, including programme-launch and six-month follow-up sessions.
Facilitated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions and designed Gemba Walk projects to identify process gaps, waste and improvement opportunities.
Organised and facilitated a 2017 Process Engineering Community Operational Meet, involving stakeholders across Europe and the US from 8 Shared Service Centres, driving cross-location problem solving and best-practice sharing.
Delivered process improvement, automation and reporting initiatives contributing to significant productivity and cost benefits, including approximately 18–22 FTE productivity benefits.
Developed MIS and Excel VBA-based F&A reporting tools supporting reporting visibility and process efficiency.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Knowledge Life Consulting Services | Consulting Manager | Pune | 08/2024 • Advised on business strategy and implementation with a focus on translating business objectives into actionable improvement
initiatives.
Assessed current-state processes to identify process gaps, pain points and improvement opportunities across finance and business operations.
Created opportunity charts for AP, AR and R2R, developed recommendations and solution options, and supported implementation planning and execution.

Shared Service Centers.
Managed and coordinated 8 Lean Six Sigma White Belt and Yellow Belt programmes, including participant planning and programme coordination, with an average batch size of 12 participants.
• Conducted Lean Six Sigma capability-building sessions through the Opportunity Hopper programme twice annually, including an
initial session at programme launch and a follow-up session after six months to identify and progress improvement opportunities. • Facilitated structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions for process issues, enabling teams to identify root causes and implement
sustainable corrective actions.
Led Lean, Six Sigma and structured problem-solving training for teams. • Created and maintained MIS/reporting solutions, including an Excel VBA-based F&A reporting tool, improving reporting visibility and management information.
Led ERP enhancement initiatives through successful completion, aligning process requirements with system improvements. • Assessed automation risks and opportunities during new transitions and identified RPA/process-automation opportunities for Finance Shared Service Centers.
Designed supervisory-level control solutions and introduced Gemba Walks and visual workplaces for daily management.
Vodafone Pvt. Ltd | Lead Transformation | Pune | 05/2011 – 11/2018 • Successfully implemented 2,000+ process automation initiatives and 100+ structured RCA initiatives across Finance Shared
Services, identifying productivity, quality and process-efficiency improvement opportunities.
Developed and implemented continuous-improvement strategies across India, APAC, EMEA and North America, driving standardisation and process optimisation across global operations.
Organised and facilitated a Process Engineering Community Operational Meet (2017) involving stakeholders across Europe and the US from 8 Shared Service Centres, bringing teams together to identify and resolve cross-shared-service process issues, share best practices and drive cost/productivity improvements.
Identified and implemented improvement opportunities across Shared Services, including eService tools and process solutions, contributing to approximately 18–22 FTE productivity benefits.
Facilitated structured RCA, process-improvement and problem-solving sessions to address operational issues and improve process performance.
Created MIS and management reporting solutions, including Excel VBA-based tools for F&A reporting and performance visibility.
Mphasis | Sr. Technical Support Officer | Pune | 01/2008 – 05/2011 • Provided technical support and solutions within an IT services environment.
Trust Systems & Software (I) Pvt. Ltd | IT Solution Provider | Nagpur | 08/2006 – 07/2007 • Delivered IT solutions and services for client requirements.
Soft Dev Solutions | Software Developer & AutoCAD Drafting | Nagpur | 07/2001 – 12/2005 • Software development and AutoCAD drafting for tailored client solutions.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS • 2,000+ Finance Shared Service Center process automations across AP, AR and R2R. • 100+ Root Cause Analyses supporting finance-process improvement and transformation. • Multi-region F&A transformation experience across India, APAC, EMEA and North America. • Finance Shared Services/BPO experience spanning 14 years, with hands-on R2R/P2P/O2C exposure. • ERP enhancement and transformation initiatives, including finance-process and automation opportunity assessment. • Current-state assessment, GAP/opportunity analysis, solution design and implementation support for AP/AR/R2R.
